name: PalmsTrack – Subscription Tracker
author: PalmsTrack

sections.description:
PalmsTrack Subscription Tracker for WordPress helps you manage your plugin subscriptions from a centralized dashboard. Monitor upcoming renewal dates from your WordPress admin dashboard, and export your data to CSV for your convenience.

Why PalmsTrack?

WordPress plugin expenses can add up fast. PalmsTrack’s Subscription Tracker helps you:
– See all your plugin subscriptions and related costs in one place.
– Catch and cancel unused renewals before they charge.
– Track spending over time to eliminate unnecessary costs.
– Gain clear insights into your plugin expenses directly from your dashboard.

Features

  • Plugin Tracking: Automatically sync your installed plugins to manage their subscriptions.
  • 3rd Party Subscriptions: Track hosting, domain, and other third‑party services alongside your plugins.
  • Renewal Alerts: Get dashboard notifications for upcoming renewals days in advance.
  • CSV Export: Backup your subscription data by exporting it into a CSV file.

Premium Features

  • Extended Subscription Tracking: Manage recurring subscriptions and other expenses from third‑party services such as hosting, domain, and SaaS services.
  • Scheduled Email Renewal Digest: Stay ahead of your expenses with daily, weekly, or monthly email digests of your upcoming renewals.
  • Advanced Organization Tools: Tag and filter subscriptions for a clear breakdown of your spending.
  • License Key Manager: Store license keys and manage team access to them.
  • Cost Tracking and Insights: Analyze monthly and yearly expenses to optimize your budget, and generate downloadable PDF summary reports of your site expenses.
  • WordPress Insights API: Compare your spending with similar WordPress sites to make smarter financial decisions.
  • Your Data, Your Server: All subscription data stays on your WordPress site—no external servers, no third‑party access. Full control, maximum privacy. *Data is shared only with your consent for insights.
sections.installation:
From the WordPress Plugin Repository

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “PalmsTrack Subscription Tracker”.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the latest release as a .zip file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the .zip file, click Install Now, then Activate.
sections.faq:
How do I add a new subscription?

Installed plugins are automatically added and can be refreshed by clicking the Sync Plugins button in the My Subscriptions dashboard.

How do I export my data?

Go to My Subscriptions and click Export.
